Save, publish, preview sample data, asset use and test-send endpoints enforce current Grant actor scope; unrelated/member access denied

HTML-disabled mail retains exact decision names, verification instructions and safe URLs in meaningful plain text

Approved received samples verified separately in classic Outlook desktop, new Outlook and Outlook web; one is not evidence for another
Approved received samples verified in Apple Mail/macOS and iOS Mail, recording actual client/OS versions

320/375/390px mail preview and editor keyboard/touch flows preserve layout, protected labels, focus, minimum product target dimensions and no horizontal clipping
